Other local and private LGBT charities and foundations were supported as the event grew.  The tour began with 16 shows in 2007 expanding to 25 shows in 2008. The album contains fourteen tracks (seventeen in some territories), including the first single "Two Times Blue", released on the iTunes Store on June 6, 2007.  Harry promoted the album on Cyndi Lauper's True Colors Tour 2007, performing a number of songs from the album.  Upon its release in the UK, it debuted at #86.  In the US, it debuted at #37 on the Independent Chart.»
